description: Create, update, or delete secrets in a GitHub repository or organization.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The base URL for the GitHub API. Default: "https://api.github.com"

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: The GitHub username or organization name.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description: The name of the repository. If not provided, the secret will be managed at the organization level.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The desired state of the secret. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The GitHub token used for authentication.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value of the secret. Required when state=present.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: The visibility of the secret when set at the organization level. Required when state=present and repository is not set. Choices: "all" "private" "selected"

examples:
- name: Add Github secret
  community.general.github_secrets:
    token: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'GITHUB_TOKEN') }}"
    repository: "ansible"
    organization: "ansible"
    key: "TEST_SECRET"
    value: "bob"
    state: "present"

- name: Delete Github secret
  community.general.github_secrets:
    token: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'GITHUB_TOKEN') }}"
    repository: "ansible"
    organization: "ansible"
    key: "TEST_SECRET"
    state: "absent"

return_values.name: result
return_values.description: The result of the module. Returned: always Sample: {"msg": "OK (2 bytes)", "response": "Secret created", "status": 201}
